newsitem.title: TURKEY: Canadian, two Turks hurt in Istanbul bomb blast.
newsitem.headline: Canadian, two Turks hurt in Istanbul bomb blast.

text.p: A fragmentation bomb exploded in the historic Sultanahmet district of Istanbul on Sunday injuring three people, including a Canadian tourist, the state-run Anatolian news agency said.
Anatolian said the injured tourist, identified as Koren Rego, 36, was treated and released at a nearby hospital. Two Turks also hurt in the blast remained in hospital.
The bomb, hidden near a garbage bin in front of the Hotel Karasu in Sultanahmet, a popular tourist area at the heart of Old Istanbul, exploded at 1000 GMT, the news agency said.
Police were investigating the blast but have not commented on who may have been responsible for the bombing, it said.
